bio: I'm a junior at Tufts studying Computer Science, with minors in Finance and AI Development. I like markets and systems for the same reason, they're built on logic that isn't always obvious, and figuring out why something counterintuitive works is where I learn the most. That's the lens I bring to research, startups, and building things people actually use. Outside of that, I write for the Tufts Daily, compete with the Tufts Ballroom Club, and almost always have a book going.

bullets: Co-authored a research manuscript accepted for publication by IEEE-HKN, testing and evaluating YOLO and RF-DETR architectures for fish migration tracking
Evaluated and selected open-source LLM architectures for fine-tuning on addiction therapy applications, researching tradeoffs in model size, training requirements, and domain suitability

Configured and operated LiDAR equipment to collect 3D spatial data, processing raw scans into refined point cloud representations to support a spatial mapping tool for firefighter navigation and situational awareness
Labeled datasets of up to 300 images using Roboflow to train various models
Developed and tested a trade management platform supporting real-time risk assessment and transparent commodities data for futures and options trading
Led quality checks on the data pipeline, finding and fixing recurring bugs to ensure the options systems received clean, accurate data
Researched and analyzed futures and options data to build an efficient, accurate representation of input data
